sentences.en: I have plenty of things to eat in the pantry.
sentences.zh: 1. 我在食品储藏室里有很多吃的东西。

sentences.en: I found this in the back of the pantry.
sentences.zh: 2. 我在食品储藏室后面找到了这个东西。

sentences.en: I used to volunteer at the food pantry around the corner.
sentences.zh: 3. 我过去常常在街角的食品发放站做志愿者。

senses.zh: 餐具室，食品储存室,〈美俚〉胃
